_comment: What the leaderboard website publishes for the multilingual pedagogy cluster. Same format
- cluster_name: the cluster slug the website and the output filenames key on.
- benchmarks: one entry per language, each its own benchmark. THE ORDER OF THIS LIST
IS THE ORDER OF THE COLUMNS ON THE WEBSITE.
- benchmark_domain: the benchmark_slug of the result files, CDPK-<ISO 639 code>
(2-letter code when one exists, else 3-letter: prs = Dari, nyn = Nyankore).
- display_name: the label shown in the website's selector.
- metrics: the metrics shown for that benchmark. Copied into each
English (CDPK-en) is not here: it is published from LLM_benchmark for now. Merging
LLM_benchmark and pedagogy-benchmark into one repo is left for later
is_bad_format_scored is true, as for CDPK-en: an answer the regex parser cannot read
counts as wrong, as on the current multilingual leaderboard.
